### NAME

`syft` - Anchore Syft — SBOM generation CLI for container images and filesystems.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
curl -sSfL https://get.anchore.io/syft | sudo sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin
```

```
# container image
syft alpine:latest

# directory
syft ./my-project
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

**A CLI tool and Go library for generating a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) from container images and filesystems. Exceptional for vulnerability detection when used with a scanner like [Grype](https://github.com/anchore/grype).** &nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/anchore/syft/actions/workflows/validations.yaml" target="_blank"><img alt="Validations" src="https://github.com/anchore/syft/actions/workflows/validations.yaml/badge.svg"></a>&nbsp; &nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/anchore/syft/releases/latest" target="_blank"><img alt="GitHub release" src="https://img.shields.io/github/release/anchore/syft.svg"></a>&nbsp; &nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/anchore/syft" target="_blank"><img alt=
